inline_comments.comment: `# creates: cu.png` is a directive from the old ASE documentation build system (agdocs), not a sphinx-gallery feature. The identical comment exists verbatim in the legacy source file `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` and has simply been carried over. Sphinx-gallery does not recognise or act on `# creates:` comments — the `remove_config_comments` config setting only removes `# sphinx_gallery_*` prefixed comments — so this line will render as a plain code comment in the gallery output, misleading readers. Remove it entirely.

The `filename='cu.png'` argument causes `bs.plot()` to write `cu.png` into whatever the current working directory is at build time. In a sphinx-gallery context this is both redundant and problematic: sphinx-gallery already captures all open matplotlib figures automatically (by scanning the figure stack at the end of each cell) and saves them under its own `examples_generated/` output tree. The extra `cu.png` artifact won't be captured in the gallery's managed output and won't be removed by `make clean` unless an explicit clean target handles it. Per project rules, gallery-generated output files must be removed by `make clean`. Consider dropping `filename='cu.png'` entirely and letting sphinx-gallery manage the figure — or, if the download is intentionally provided to users, verify the file is listed in a clean target.

general_comments.comment: The migration is incomplete: the old source file `doc/ase/dft/bs.py` is still present in the repository and has not been deleted by this PR. Additionally, `doc/gallery/gallery.rst` still contains a 'Band-structure' section (lines 43–50) that references `../ase/dft/cu.png` via `.. image::` and links to `../ase/dft/bs.py` via `:download:`. Both the old script and that gallery.rst section must be removed in the same PR. Per project conventions for tutorial migrations: delete the old Python scripts, their associated generated images, and all toctree or manual-gallery references in the same MR as the addition of the new sphinx-gallery file. Leaving the old entry in `gallery.rst` means two separate places will document the same example, and the legacy `:download:` link will eventually break.
